user.title: Connect your NIO vehicle
user.description: Sniff the vehicle status request from the NIO app (MITM proxy), then paste the full request URL and the Authorization Bearer token here.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate NIO
reauth_confirm.description: Your NIO token was rejected. Sniff a fresh token from the app and paste it below. If the sign/device parameters changed too, paste the new status URL as well.

error.invalid_url: Could not parse vehicle_id / device_id / sign from the URL — paste the complete request URL from the app.
error.invalid_auth: The NIO API rejected the token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the NIO API.

intervals.title: Polling cadence
intervals.description: Polling the private API too aggressively can get the token rate-limited or invalidated.

credentials.title: Update credentials
credentials.description: Paste a fresh Bearer token (re-sniff it from the NIO app). If the sign/device parameters changed too, also paste the new status request URL.
